items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Me and Richard became tight. I started Richard playing

ctx.x: But it’s obvious what you had in the case.

Yeah, a saxophone. Yeah, I’m scared. He said, “Take it out. Can you play it?” I was like, “I know Buzzy,” because I knew that one song. So he said, “Buzzy? What’s Buzzy?” So I took it out, and I played [McLean sings the opening phrase], and he started playing. That was it. He was impressed, because I was playing – by this time I was playing two years and had been practicing and had been trying to play anything of Bird’s that I could or anything of Pres’s, Dexter. So he liked the idea that I was so young and that…
